properties.name: ecdat:actions
properties.value: Quantum-vulnerable cryptography must be replaced by the national full-adoption deadline of 2029-12-31, whatever the sector.

properties.name: ecdat:actions
properties.value: NIST deprecates 112-bit-classical asymmetric cryptography (RSA-2048 and RSA-3072 among them) after 2030 and DISALLOWS it entirely after 2035. Deprecated means "may be used but the risk is accepted knowingly"; disallowed means it may not be used at all. Plan to complete migration before 2030, not before 2035.

properties.name: ecdat:actions
properties.value: Replace with a post-quantum algorithm chosen by USAGE: ML-KEM (FIPS 203) for key establishment and key transport, ML-DSA (FIPS 204) for signatures, or SLH-DSA (FIPS 205) where a conservative hash-based signature is preferred. ECDAT could not determine the usage of this key -- typically a generation site whose use is in another function -- and will not guess, because a wrong target here is a wrong migration. Increasing the key size does not help.

properties.name: ecdat:actions
properties.value: Replace with ML-DSA (FIPS 204), or SLH-DSA (FIPS 205) where a conservative hash-based signature is preferred. This is a SIGNING key, so a KEM is not the replacement. Migrate the VERIFIERS first: nothing can accept an ML-DSA signature until its verifier does, so a signer that moves ahead of its verifiers breaks the service. Increasing the key size does not help.
